Research & intelligence software

Pharos Onion Researcher

Hybrid search and source relationship analysis.

A self-hosted research platform bringing onion-service search, infrastructure relationships and changes over time into one investigative workspace.

Self-hosted source project

The need

Finding scattered records is only the beginning. Researchers also need to inspect relationships and understand what changed over time.

Approach

Hybrid BM25/vector search, entity pivots across wallet/PGP/favicon/server fingerprints, snapshots, diffs, clone candidates and watchlists.

Current scope and limits

The underlying source application is self-hosted Pharos; Onion Researcher is the portfolio presentation name. Clone results are candidates, not definitive attribution. No live crawl was performed; historical index/test counts are not current metrics.

Published information checked on 5 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
